guide.overview: Red Hood is a Firepower who thrives on **Crits**. When his **basic attacks deal Crit DMG**, he deals **additional AoE DMG**.

legacyPieces.name: T-Sphere Weakness Analyzer
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Crit Rate and Crit Damage, and grants an additional Crit Damage bonus when Red Hood casts his Ultimate. Red Hood relies on Crit Damage from his basic attacks to trigger grenade throws and deal AoE damage, and the T-Sphere Weakness Analyzer greatly boosts his Crit Rate and damage.

legacyPieces.name: Gas Derringer
legacyPieces.reason: Significantly increases Attack and Crit Damage. Red Hood's Crit Rate scales with the number of nearby enemies, so higher Crit Damage lets him deal devastating AoE damage in combat.

legacyPieces.name: Lawton Rifle Scope
legacyPieces.reason: Provides steady Attack and Crit Rate bonuses. Red Hood's Dodge increases after casting his Ultimate, and the Attack bonus makes his strafing attack hit harder.
